relationships.subject: ROS-mediated mitochondrial dysfunction
relationships.evidence_quote: ROS-mediated mitochondrial dysfunction is one of the critical mediators of NLRP3 inflammasome activation.

relationships.subject: NLRP3
relationships.evidence_quote: NLRP3 inflammasome in turn cause ROS production and mitochondrial dysfunction

relationships.subject: PGC-1alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: The activation of PGC-1α shifts the microglial phenotype via the modulation of a feedback loop between ROS-mediated mitochondrial dysfunction and the NLRP3 inflammasome.

key_findings: CCI induces ROS-mediated mitochondrial dysfunction and NLRP3 activation with M2-to-M1 microglia shift
